text_blocks.snippet: High blood pressure (hypertension) is consistently measured at or above 130/80 mm Hg.
según guidelines from the American Heart Association, blood pressure is grouped into the following ranges:

If your blood pressure reading is higher than 180/120 mm Hg and you have warning signs like chest pain, shortness of breath, back pain, numbness, weakness, or trouble speaking, call 911 immediately. If your reading is above 180/120 mm Hg without symptoms, wait 5 minutes and test again; if it remains high, contact your doctor right away.
